newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Timing of EMU budget pact accord uncertain - Quinn.
newsitem.headline: Timing of EMU budget pact accord uncertain - Quinn.

text.p: Irish Finance Minister Ruairi Quinn said on Wednesday it was unclear whether the details of a budget stability pact under a single European currency could be agreed by year-end.
Speaking to the European Parliament, Quinn said "It remains to be seen how far the details of the work on the stability pact can be specified by the end of the Irish presidency."
He was none the less hopeful that it would be possible for EU leaders to make further progress on a disciplinary budget accord when they meet in Dublin on December 13 and 14.

Monetary sources said on Wednesday the EU's monetary committee remained divided over several important aspects of a budget pact that penalises governments running deficits above three percent of total output.
Quinn added that a budget stability pact would also aim to create "conditions in which low interest rates will be consistent with low inflation."
Such an outcome would help to promote investment and maximise sustainable growth and employment.
